August, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:56129
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8768 of 2024
Applicant :- Dheeraj

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Salim Khan,Narendra Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.194 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Machhrehta, District Sitapur.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that daughter of the informant was married to the applicant two years ago and subsequently, the entire family member used to harass her and on 19.06.2024, they had killed her.

The cause of death as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, four contusion injuries were observed on the thigh, knees and elbow, which according to the applicant can happen when the body was lowered.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the post-mortem report and the fact that there is no allegation that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry at the instance of the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 25.07.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Dheeraj be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.8.2024 nishant  Dheeraj vs State Of U.P.Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76354358/
